heroSummary: Anoka-Hennepin does not start every grade on the same day in 2026–27. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin Tuesday, September 8; other grades report Wednesday, September 9; and kindergarten families follow their school's Welcome Week schedule for September 8–11. Students have no school for MEA October 15–16. Students are off December 24–January 1 and March 29–April 2, and the last day of school is June 10.

calendarNotes: The 2026-27 K-12 calendar uses three trimesters and separates district holidays, student-free staff days, grade-specific closures, and school breaks. October 26 applies only to elementary students. November 25 is a conference conversion day before the November 26-27 district holidays. December 4 and 7 are student-free dates at the first trimester transition; March 15 is the corresponding planning and grading day after trimester two. Elementary Digital Days run 1-5, while Middle School Digital Days run 1-2. Those codes describe schedule rotations and are not attendance events. If emergency closures reduce instructional days, the district may convert a non-school date or extend the year.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Anoka-Hennepin start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Grades 7–8 and 10–12 report September 9. Kindergarten families follow their school's Welcome Week schedule for September 8–11.
They are class-rotation codes. Elementary schools use a 1–5 rotation and middle schools use a 1–2 rotation. A Digital Day number does not mean remote learning or no school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Anoka-Hennepin MEA break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students have no school Thursday and Friday, October 15–16, 2026, for MEA.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Anoka-Hennepin Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are off from December 24, 2026, through January 1, 2027. The PDF distinguishes district holidays on December 24–25 and January 1 from Winter Break on December 28–31.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Anoka-Hennepin Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are off March 29 through April 2, 2027. March 29–31 is labeled Spring Break, and April 1–2 are district holidays.

calendarFaqs.q: Is October 26 a no-school day for all Anoka-Hennepin students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The official calendar labels October 26 as no school for elementary students only. Middle- and high-school students are not included in that closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Anoka-Hennepin school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day and the end of Trimester 3 are Thursday, June 10, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How are Anoka-Hennepin emergency closure days made up?
calendarFaqs.a: The district may convert a non-school day or extend the school year. No fixed make-up date is printed in advance, so follow the district's later announcement.
